agent_answer:
C. Yvonne

Yvonne’s response revealed she could only attend or help under earlier-time conditions. Specifically, she said she could help with the park birthday on Saturday mornings **before 9** and could attend only **if it was before noon**, because she works nights through most of February. That conditional wording showed her actual position was limited by her work schedule, even though she was happy to support the plan.
